info.title: SIH26189 Investigation API
info.description: Case-scoped source evidence and versioned analysis. Scores are investigative leads, not criminality probabilities.

get.description: What changes between two runs (e.g. observed_only vs observed_plus_inferred).
Why this person ranks where they do in an analysis run, in plain terms with supporting numbers.
What to upload. The frontend can show this as help text.

post.description: Dry run: checks the files and returns the report. Writes nothing.
Validate, then create a NEW case. On any validation error nothing is written and the report is returned (422).

get.description: Who used the system, when, and what they touched, over the last N hours.
Check every non-admin user against the cases they can open: name or e-mail matching a case subject.
Who is calling, their portal role and which cases they can open (drives which view the UI shows).
